name: io.github.ych/oifs
title: OIFS Memory Sandbox
description: Local-only single-file POSIX inode filesystem MCP server with optional XAES-256-GCM encryption, Zstd/SIMD compression, WAL journaling, CoW branching, and anti-token-drain pagination.

packageArguments.description: Path to the single-file .img container sandbox (created automatically if missing unless --read-only is set).

packageArguments.name: --size
packageArguments.description: Initial image size in MB when creating a new image (default 10).

packageArguments.name: --journal
packageArguments.description: Enable CRC32C metadata Write-Ahead Logging when creating a new image.

packageArguments.name: --no-mmap
packageArguments.description: Use pure positional pread/pwrite storage engine (zero mmap).

packageArguments.name: --read-only
packageArguments.description: Open existing image with shared F_RDLCK lock and reject all mutations.

packageArguments.name: --dict
packageArguments.description: Load a trained Zstd dictionary file at startup.

packageArguments.name: --cipher
packageArguments.description: Encryption cipher for new encrypted images: aes256-gcm (default) or xchacha20-poly1305.

environmentVariables.name: OIFS_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Optional encryption passphrase. When set, opens an existing encrypted container or initializes a new encrypted container; never stored or transmitted over the network.

environmentVariables.name: OIFS_STORAGE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Optional default storage mode override ('mmap' or 'pread').
